title: You can do everything right… Great content. Strong reputation. Smart ...
description: You can do everything right… Great content. Strong reputation. Smart ads. And still lose the client. Why? Because speed beats skill. Responding to a new lead in the first 60 seconds can increase conversions by 391%. And 78% of buyers hire the first business to respond — not the best one. So if someone fills out your form while you’re grabbing lunch… Whoever replies first usually wins. Not because they’re better. Because they’re faster.
transcript: Let me give you some numbers here because they completely changed how I think about my entire business. You see, I used to think that responding to a new lead within 47 minutes was fast. Turns out, I wasn't even close. Velocifi, a lead management research company, found that responding within the first one minute increases conversions by 391%. Not 3%, not even 39%, but 391% within the first 60 seconds. And then, LeadConnect found that 78% of buyers purchase from whichever business responds first. That's right. They don't hire whoever's best or whoever's cheapest. They hire the first business to respond. Just think about that for a second. You spend weeks on your content, you spend months building your reputation, thousands potentially on your ads, and then someone fills out your form while you're eating lunch and the first person to reply wins, regardless of who's actually better.
